  * @brief   Description of the GPIO example.

  @endverbatim

@par Example Description

How to configure and use GPIOs through the HAL API. PA05 gpio pin is linked to LED2.
In this example, HCLK is configured at 84 MHz.

@note Care must be taken when using HAL_Delay().
